prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: State Bar of California Attorney Search
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer from directory listings alone. I’d shortlist **two or three firms that regularly handle car-crash injury cases**, then choose after speaking with the attorney who would actually handle your case.

A few options to contact for a free initial consultation:

- **GJEL Accident Attorneys** — has a Pleasanton car-accident page and advertises free case reviews: [GJEL Pleasanton](https://www.gjel.com/pleasanton).
- **O’Connor, Runckel & O’Malley LLP** — Walnut Creek-based, serves Pleasanton, and describes handling auto-injury cases: [firm website](https://www.orolawfirm.com/pleasanton-personal-injury-lawyer).
- **Venardi Zurada** — serves Pleasanton and advertises free consultations: [Pleasanton car-accident page](https://www.vzlawfirm.com/pleasanton/car-accident-lawyer/).
- **A local-office option:** Teresa Li’s firm lists a Pleasanton office and free initial consultations: [profile and contact details](https://lawyers.findlaw.com/california/pleasanton/law-offices-of-teresa-li-pc-NTI0MTkyMF8x/).

These are starting points, not endorsements; firm websites and review listings don’t establish who will be the best fit. Before signing, ask:

1. Who will personally handle my case, and how often will I hear from them?
2. Have you handled cases with injuries and circumstances like mine?
3. What is the contingency fee, and what case costs might I owe if there’s no recovery?
4. What would you do next, and what could affect the value or timing of my claim?

Check the attorney’s license status and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of California Attorney Search](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/attorneysearch). Don’t sign under pressure, and don’t give a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer before getting advice. If you tell me how serious your injuries are, whether fault is disputed, and whether you’ve already spoken with an insurer, I can help you narrow the questions to ask.
